owner: Store canonical JSON admission over an immutable framework Value source
representation: Objects must have unique keys. Raw DslValue preserves duplicate entries and cannot directly implement the canonical JSON trait.

limits.maximumRetainedBytes: Requested numeric key-index capacity is checked before reservation; actual reported capacity is checked before admitting the empty table. Allocator-private memory, fixed traversal metadata, and source ownership are excluded.

grant.zeroItemsOrBytes: Active admission reports blocked without mutation when either allowance is zero; close reports blocked without mutation only when structural allowance is zero.
grant.byteWork: Hash or compare at most minimum(maximumBytes,256) raw UTF-8 bytes; split codepoints are valid because bytes are never reinterpreted
grant.allocation: One checked numeric-table reservation is one structural item; slots initialize individually and never reallocate
grant.close: One numeric slot, empty allocation, traversal frame, or exact source transfer per positive structural allowance; no byte allowance is consumed.

lifecycle: Admission owns the source until success transfers a validated immutable wrapper, or bounded close clears the numeric table and returns the identical source. Wrapper exposes only borrowed indexed JSON and consuming source transfer.
duplicates: Reject before a canonical wrapper exists; no hashes or persisted bytes may be published from rejected input.
closeReceipt: returned with source, structuralItems and checkpoint
